question_or_proposition: For Outfall 001 Total Dissolved Solids, do the 'Report' entries in all discharge limitation columns signify that no enforceable numeric effluent limit applies (only measured-value reporting), and does footnote *1 ('When discharging') condition the 1/Quarter grab monitoring requirement on actual discharge occurrence at this intermittent-flow outfall?
required_context: Section A.1 FINAL Effluent Limits – Outfall 001 – Intermittent Flow
DISCHARGE LIMITATIONS table, Total Dissolved Solids row
source_locator: page 3, part_i, Section A.1, DISCHARGE LIMITATIONS table (TDS row)
notes: The nominated TDS row pairs report-only limit notation with discharge-conditioned quarterly monitoring. Resolving whether 'Report' excludes numeric compliance comparison affects Purpose A exceedance evaluation; resolving *1 applicability affects Purpose B monitoring-obligation timing and Purpose C classification of missing TDS results during no-discharge versus discharge periods.
